requirements.quote: Joint venture Agreement including split of work signed by both parties;
requirements.text: Provide a signed joint venture agreement detailing the split of work.

requirements.quote: The original or certified copy of the B-BBEE certificate of the joint venture;
requirements.text: Submit the original or certified B-BBEE certificate for the joint venture.

requirements.quote: The Tax Clearance Certificate of each joint venture member;
requirements.text: Provide the tax clearance certificates for all joint venture members.
Submit proof of ownership or shareholder certificates.

requirements.quote: An omission to disclose material information, a factual inaccuracy, and/or a misrepresentation of fact may result in the disqualification of a tender, or cancellation of any subsequent contract.
requirements.text: Ensure all information is accurate and complete to avoid disqualification.

requirements.quote: Failure to comply with any of the terms and conditions as set out in this document will invalidate the Proposal.
requirements.text: Adhere to all terms and conditions to validate the proposal.
CSIR may extend the proposal closing date.

requirements.quote: Verify any information contained in a proposal;
requirements.text: CSIR reserves the right to verify proposal information.

requirements.quote: Request documentary proof regarding any tendering issue;
requirements.text: CSIR may request additional documentary proof.

requirements.quote: Give preference to locally manufactured goods;
requirements.text: CSIR may prioritize locally manufactured goods.

requirements.quote: Appoint one or more service providers, separately or jointly (whether or not they submitted a joint proposal);
requirements.text: CSIR can appoint multiple service providers, jointly or separately.

requirements.quote: Award this RFP as a whole or in part;
requirements.text: CSIR may award the RFP in full or partially.

requirements.quote: Cancel or withdraw this RFP as a whole or in part.
requirements.text: CSIR reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the RFP.

requirements.quote: This RFP is a request for proposals only and not an offer document.
requirements.text: Understand that the RFP is not an offer document.

requirements.quote: Answers to this RFP must not be construed as acceptance of an offer or imply the existence of a contract between the parties.
requirements.text: Responses to the RFP do not constitute a contract.

requirements.quote: By submission of its proposal, tenderers shall be deemed to have satisfied themselves with and to have accepted all Terms & Conditions of this RFP.
requirements.text: Submitting a proposal implies acceptance of all RFP terms.
